bugs.description: The shared management predicate dropped the tenant comparison, allowing a manager from another tenant to read workspace secrets.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: An actor with workspace:manage permission supplies a workspace belonging to a different tenant.
bugs.observableImpact: The actor receives another tenant's workspace secret.
bugs.provenance: Seeded from a base shared predicate that required both matching tenantId and workspace:manage permission. Confirmed by curator-only executable proof.

bugs.description: The same weakened shared predicate allows a manager from another tenant to modify workspace settings.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: An actor with workspace:manage permission supplies a workspace belonging to a different tenant and calls updateSetting.
bugs.observableImpact: A cross-tenant workspace setting is modified.
bugs.provenance: Second independently executable symptom of the same seeded shared-predicate root cause.
